title: L3-L4 facet contact force at 7.5 Nm, bilateral extra-articular strain (EAS) method
condition: intact (posterior L3-L4 capsules cut for Tekscan)

quantity.name: facet contact force
quantity.definition: resultant normal facet joint contact force per facet (left/right) at 7.5 Nm, bilateral EAS strain-gauge model calibrated by direct indentation; mean, SD (n=10), min/max over per-specimen values; negative = compressive, positive = tensile

source.authors: Zhu QA, Park YB, Sjovold SG, Niosi CA, Wilson DC, Cripton PA, Oxland TR
source.sample: 10 specimens (human cadaveric L2-L5); 10 fresh-frozen human cadaveric L2-L5 lumbar spines; facet forces at the L3-L4 joints (gauges on L3 inferior facets)

protocol.summary: L2-L5 specimens, L2 and L5 potted in dental stone (L3-L4 disc horizontal), all ligaments/capsules/discs intact except posterior L3-L4 capsules cut for Tekscan sensors; pure moment +-7.5 Nm, 3 cycles each of flexion-extension, bilateral lateral bending, bilateral axial torsion, ~2 deg/s, unconstrained (custom spine tester); no preload; peak facet contact force at peak moment; cycle used for evaluation not stated.
how_to_simulate: Fix L5 (caudal potting); leave L2-L5 otherwise unconstrained; posterior L3-L4 capsules cut (Tekscan) - capsules remain for EAS but were cut in this test
Apply pure moment +-7.5 Nm to L2 in flexion, extension, left/right lateral bending and left/right axial rotation, no preload
Report resultant normal contact force in left and right L3-L4 facet joints at peak moment (compressive negative, tensile positive)
For lateral bending and axial rotation compare the maximum compressive force in each facet during the bilateral test
protocol.notes: Method: 10 uniaxial strain gauges on posterior surface of L3 inferior facets, bilateral (strain-coupled) cantilever-plate model, least-squares calibration on 16-25 indentation points per facet. EAS accuracy ~20% (direct) and ~30% (disarticulated); repeatability CV 5% in axial rotation. Soft-tissue artefact (virtual facet load after facetectomy, separate 6 L3-S1 specimens, Table 4) r.m.s. 34 N flexion, 35 N extension, 20 N LB, 12 N AR - so flexion/extension/LB EAS values carry large error; authors recommend use only in axial rotation. Abstract averages L/R: AR 71+-25, EX 27+-35, LB 25+-28 N compressive, flexion tensile 25+-45 N.
